Faculty Profile

Dr. Ru Shan Shy

ZSA Educator · Clinical Practice · Neuroscience-Informed Teaching

Dr. Ru Shan Shy is a direct disciple of Professor Ming Qing Zhu and an international educator in Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture. Her training includes medicine at China Medical University, graduate study at National Taiwan University, and advanced doctoral-level neuroscience training at the Institute of Neuroscience, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, Taiwan. Her work integrates classical Chinese medicine, clinical observation and neuroscience-informed reasoning.
